items.title: Cowboys’ Rally Comes up Short in 24-17 Loss to New Mexico
items.summary: LARAMIE, Wyoming (11/20/26) – The University of Wyoming football team's comeback fell short on Friday night at War Memorial Stadium. New Mexico held on for a 24-17 victory to move back into first place of the Mountain West Conference standings.

items.title: Border War Suspended in 2027
items.summary: An iconic tradition dating back to the 19th century is taking a pause for the 2027 football season. The “Border War” between Wyoming and Colorado State will not take place next year amid scheduling changes from the team south of the border.

items.title: WYOMING ATHLETICS ANNOUNCES "LIGHT UP LARADISE" FOR NOVEMBER 20 FOOTBALL SHOWDOWN AGAINST NEW MEXICO
items.summary: LARAMIE, Wyo. (Nov. 11, 2026) – Wyoming Athletics is calling on Cowboy Country to help create one of the most electric atmospheres in War Memorial Stadium history with the launch of "Light Up Laradise," a first-of-its-kind fan experience set for Friday, Nov. 20, when the Wyoming Cowboys host nationally ranked New Mexico at 7 p.m.

items.title: How ‘Bout Them Cowboys
